finding: float64 roundoff, not a conservation error. The node-sum balance identities hold algebraically for the implemented right-hand side; on the saved final states their residuals are about 1e-18 (r1) and 1e-15 (r2) in extended precision (np.longdouble), and below 2e-35 in ChatGPT's independent 40-digit check (review/MG010_chatgpt.md). In float64 the same states give r2 between 3e-12 and 3e-10, varying from state to state, above the registered absolute floor of 1e-10 on the degree-12 R graphs.
